intent_scope: One explicit independent file/locator/note create per transaction, base_revision_id=null. No existing-object editor, Entity/Collection updates, automatic dedupe, new Source/Algorithm type, provider/network execution.

workspace.prepared_input: source_root/<transaction_id>/DRAFT.json plus exactly declared docs/original payload; no journal/status/lock/temp files in publishable inventory
workspace.roots: New own authoring_root disjoint from the unchanged six base Backend roots. Compose existing Backend with its original six-key map; do not pass seven keys to Backend.config. Reject overlap and source selection from Bank/intake/stage/cache/output/source/authoring roots.
workspace.lock: Owned native file-handle workspace lock serializes allocation/reservation/creation/recovery; automatically released on process exit, no stale existence-only lock. Cross-process collision returns controlled busy. Native lifetime/ACL/race proof required.
workspace.retain: No automatic deletion, TTL or reclamation, including accepted/failed/UNKNOWN. Finite quota yields controlled refusal and existing items stay inspectable. Later explicit maintenance has its own scope.

serialization: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN/BOM, strict duplicate/depth parser; IDs UUIDv4 and all allocated timestamps frozen once in INTENT. Reopen/retry reuses saved exact document/draft/payload bytes, never regenerates JSON/IDs/date from current form or original path.
preparation_order: Validate input/profile/root capability and reserve bounded capacity under lock before acknowledging an intent.
Allocate IDs/time once. Exclusively write+flush+readback INTENT.pending, then publish INTENT.json without replace.
Read explicitly selected source via pinned read-only native handle, stream to private exclusive owned payload. Write exact document and DRAFT.pending; flush/close/audit every owned file.
Persist immutable SEAL.pending→SEAL.json, pinning INTENT SHA, exact DRAFT SHA, actual files sizes/hashes and policy version.
Rename the matching closed DRAFT.pending to DRAFT.json without replacement; audit strict inventory+seal. PREPARED is a verified observed state, not a status string written early.
Only then delegate publish/inspect/resume and save/receipt to unchanged components.

state_rules.observed: No published INTENT or invalid control bytes
state_rules.action: No acknowledged new intent/NO_VALID_INTENT; bounded partial files retained, never mark prepared or allocate replacement retry IDs.

INCOMPLETE_PREPARATION. Inspect IDs/reason; no automatic source reread/fill/recopy under same IDs. Cancel may preserve incomplete state. A genuinely independent new material needs explicit new-intent action.

state_rules.observed: Valid SEAL and matching complete DRAFT.pending/payloads
state_rules.action: Explicit finish-preparation may verify all hashes and rename DRAFT.pending without replace. Original source no longer required; no resampling it.
PREPARED, immutable fields. Editing creates a separate explicit new intent; original remains recoverable.
INCOMPLETE_PUBLICATION; existing publisher cannot repair. Inspect/status remain available; preserve bytes and IDs. No hidden cleanup or automatic replacement transaction. Maintenance is follow-up.
Unchanged publisher resume or inspect/publish can verify, finalize or return ALREADY_PUBLISHED. Publication is not acceptance.

state_rules.observed: Save UNKNOWN/result lost/limit during already-accepted retry
state_rules.action: Actual receipt.get with same tx/expected manifest plus exact same-ID retry. No ACCEPTED/CANCELLED from UI guess, no replacement ID. IO_ERROR/RETAINED_WORK_LIMIT means verification incomplete.
Show exact actual receipt and refresh Bank for this intent; retained intent bytes stay available. Conflict is explicit, never automatically remapped.

working_limits.enforcement: Actual bytes including JSON escaping, entries and reservation under lock; reject before writing when possible, cooperative per-chunk cancel/time. INTENT allows the full supported note input, not only a262KiB prefix. UI fields enforce declared bounds with errors, no silent truncation or interpreting display_bytes as storage cap. Existing canonical file64MiB/package256MiB and downstream work profiles unchanged; profile snapshot retained in intent. Unsupported future profile is visible, never silently converted.

file.storage: bytes; generated safe payload/original.bin path, streamed exact length/SHA; filename metadata only; application/octet-stream fallback is explicit, not a format-extraction claim
file.provenance: Initial conservative origin unknown, source_ref null, derived_from empty; captured_at records actual app copy time once, not original authorship/mtime. Later explicit richer origin requires corresponding schema links, not guesswork.

url.storage: locator URI in existing http/https/file scheme profile validated by current format checker; exact input, no fetch/open/credentials echo
url.provenance: user_capture of the locator, source_locator equals exact URI; frozen actual link-capture time; source_ref null, derived_from empty. UI says link stored without downloading content.

note.data: kind note; explicit plain_text or markdown stored unchanged, rendered as safe plain text. First slice uses standalone targets=[]; pinned targets can be added through the existing typed seam later.
note.provenance: Explicit author user/ai/unknown (default unknown); user→user_authored, ai→ai_authored, unknown→unknown. identity/model nullable and only supplied by actual declaration. No inferred model/provider, public authorship, evidence status or knowledge freshness.

selected_original_boundary.proposal: Separate SelectedOriginal adapter for user-selected read-only external input, then unchanged private prepared-package boundary. Broader read access on the original is allowed; app-owned output remains owner/SYSTEM-private. Never repair/alter source permissions.
selected_original_boundary.capability: First implementation proves owned synthetic local fixed NTFS file cases. Require absolute local drive, no ADS/UNC/device/relative paths, no app-root overlap, no final or ancestor redirect, one hardlink, expected final path/file identity/size/mtime before/after capture and final output hash readback. Parent path leases and pinned file deny write/delete sharing during copy; fail controlled if trust/capability cannot be established. Current owner/operator/code and OS parents remain trusted; no administrator resistance.
selected_original_boundary.gate: Before adoption, native probes must prove ordinary readable source ACL can be copied privately, write/open/rename replacement is denied or detected, links/junctions/refusal/existing writer/missing/oversize/change behave honestly. No real user imports during this card.

ui_integration.proposal: New authoring window/subclass and own context/backend wrapper compose accepted Window/Backend; accepted source files stay byte-identical. One shared busy operation; no second worker independently saving/publishing while preparation runs.
ui_integration.controls: Material kind/title/content/file chooser/author choices; explicit prepare, choose existing intent and existing publish/save/receipt. Automatically select tx; no manual UUID required for creation. Immutable prepared fields are read-only; editable input changes require explicit new intent.
ui_integration.truthfulness: Result belongs to initiating tx+UI generation; switching intent clears publication/save/receipt/current panels and restores only verified matching state. An unconfirmed journal event cannot fabricate Bank acceptance.
ui_integration.cancel: Cooperative cancel only during pre-seal capture/preparation, preserving incomplete record. For existing publish/save, cancel is disabled; closing waits for actual final outcome. Do not inject async thread exceptions or label an observed commit CANCELLED.
ui_integration.minimum_UX: Clear prepared/published/accepted/incomplete/UNKNOWN/limit/busy states and same-ID recovery; no hidden automatic retry repair. File chooser cancellation creates no acknowledged new intent.

implementation_gates.required: Before relying on workspace protocol: exclusive no-overwrite control creation, file flush/readback, closed-handle seal/DRAFT rename, parent leases compatible with owned file creation, two processes serialized and OS-exit releases lock; actual interruption at every checkpoint and bounded discovery.
Before adopting SelectedOriginal: concrete Windows handle/parent trust/sharing/race/public-readable source/private-output proof above, plus final SHA/metadata oracle.

source_references.role: Desired access/sharing/CreateNew/reparse flags inform native probe; documentation does not replace actual application proof.
Flush API informs protocol; hardware/power-loss acceptance remains separate.
